signal: Role-level pain hypothesis: as a Director of Business Development at a growing services firm, Britt likely faces more target accounts than the team can personally work.

email.body1:
Britt, following Nautilent's growth, the target list almost always expands faster than the people who can personally work it.

That usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can touch before they cool, and that gap is where deals quietly slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nautilent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Britt, quick follow-up for Nautilent.

Most BD leaders don't actually know how many meetings each rep needs to book to hit the number, so the coverage gap surfaces late in the quarter when it is hardest to recover. The math usually breaks well before you notice it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Nautilent needs to hit target this quarter, and where the gap opens if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Britt, last bit of proof for Nautilent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nautilent's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Britt, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. BD leaders are pulled in a dozen directions, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your BD motion? I'll tailor it to Nautilent either way.
